description:
Job Description: 
 Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc (AMA) is seeking a part-time intern to support the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA Langley Research Center. The CAD Model Design Intern will support the Entry Systems Modeling project to develop free flight and forced oscillation model design for rapid prototype fabrication. Project activities include but are not limited to, forced oscillation and free flight tests to investigate the dynamic stability of blunt entry vehicles. The models to be tested include variations of geometries. Forced oscillation testing and free flight testing will provide static and dynamic stability data for the geometries tested as well as free flight dynamics which will serve as validation data for trajectory simulation analysis.
 Responsibilities 
 Develop models in in the form of .igs or .stp, as well as the native CAD format used for the design work
 Develop CAD models for oscillation configurations that include location of mounting interface at specified reference points,
 Design geometry to accommodate thermal inset fasteners for accurate and reliable mounting to the balance sting
 Create CAD solid models of free flight wind tunnel models using FDM 3D printing methods or similar.
 Design the models to enable a movable center of gravity
 Requirements 
 Undergraduate or Graduate student with a degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering
 Minimum of 2 years’ experience in developing CAD models or 2 semesters of relevant CAD course

description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
As a Deployment Strategist Intern, you'll work as part of a diverse, generative, and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most important problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. The problems you'll solve will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, an ability to speak the language of data, and an understanding that humans should make decisions.
 
At its core, this role is about uncovering dots and—without knowing the shape they form—figuring out how to connect them. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

Hiring Our Heroes Fellowship: Cohort 27-1 Key Role: 
 Join Booz Allen as a Hiring Our Heroes (HOH) Fellow and take part in a structured program built to support your transition from military service, veteran career or career as a military spouse. Throughout the fellowship, you’ll explore our core markets and capabilities, participate in professional and technical learning opportunities, and gain exposure to how we deliver mission impact. You’ll engage with colleagues across the company, connect with mentors and leaders, and experience our culture in a collaborative hybrid environment. Along the way, you’ll build lasting relationships, expand your network, and discover how your military experience can create impact in a new setting. Fellowships are primarily hybrid, with some remote opportunities available. 
 Join us. The world can’t wait. 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 SkillBridge fellows must be on active duty or transition leave 
 SkillBridge fellows must be within 180 days of transition from military service for the duration of the 12-week program 
 Military spouses must be registered HOH Career Forward Fellowship or DoD Career Accelerator Program for consideration 
 Veterans must be registered for HOH Career Forward Fellowship Program for consideration 
 Transitioning service members, veterans, and military spouses must meet HOH and/or DoD requirements for a fellowship program 
 Ability to obtain a U.S. Government Security Clearance 
 High School Diploma or GED
